These are great !! They're soft and flexible they didn't leak or break the colors are on point . I am very happy with this purchase. I will try to update my review if anything goes wrong which I hope doesn't happen because I really like these.  Update: still good, they work nicely. No leaks. It does not work for hand sanitizer it leaks out and makes a mess. But I do wish I didn’t return the product so I could travel with my lotions and conditioners instead of wasting money on travel size products. Also customer serve is 20/10 great job.

I like to travel with skin oils and noticed the opening causes the oil to come out very quickly since their is no "filter" type stoppage integration by its opening to slow down the fluid.  That's really the only thing i have to critic...otherwise its great!!

I bought these because I was tired of spending money on travel size lotion. These are a perfect size, I have one in my purse and one in the car. They are easy to fill and convenient to carry with you. Now that i have these, my hands are no longer dry from all the frequent hand washing. I highly recommend.

reviews.t: Very handy to put in my travel bag.
reviews.x: I used these to travel on the plane in my hand bag very easy and no questions asked at border.

The labels it came with don't stick to the silicone very well so they come off after the first or second use once they get wet. The bottles are easy to fill and clean and get the soap/etc out but they do leak a little. I always put my travel toiletries in a zip lock for extra security and I am glad I did. Not terrible but wish they were a little more sealed. Definitely dont leak bad but aren't perfect. I like the colors and the fact that you can squeeze them rather than the standard hard travel

reviews.t: to fill bottle - open snap-on cap and twist the base of the snap on cap
reviews.x: I have rheumatoid  arthritis & refilling the bottles are easy - just  open snap-on cap and twist the base of the snap on cap.
I love these. I just found them hard to clean completely because of the material
I travel pretty frequently and shower at the gym and stuff, these are perfect.
Bought these for travel but as you can see, these are not worth it.

reviews.t: I bought these for traveling.  They leak when flying. :( would not recommend.
reviews.x: When flying, they leak! :( would not recommend for travel.

I used the product to place a small amount of ointment, to be used daily.  Within one week, it became a disappointment, and embarrassment.  While the silicone material of the tube itself is quite excellent (pliable, soft to touch), the cap section does not work well at all.  In short time, it loses the ability to operate: the cap becomes unusable/unworkable and does not (cannot) stay on, and like elastic that has aged and stretched, it can no longer do the job.  It needs further refining by Rese

reviews.t: No "+" valve in cap -- makes all the difference
reviews.x: I have had silicone travel bottles in the past and was hoping these would be equivalent. But these don't have that little burping + cut seal in the cap that prevents the contents from flowing out unless the bottle is squeezed. And flow out it does. If you stand the bottle on its cap, the contents will start to run out as soon as you open the cap. If you leave them cap-up, then you have to open the cap, invert the bottle, and wait ... and wait ... for the contents to flow to the cap. Nope. Didn't

I wanted to like these, but they're so bad. The tops of the bottles do not stay on securely. They will come right off and everything in the bottle will leak out. I discovered this the hard way when while on a trip my entire bag got filled with shampoo after the top came off. In addition, because the bottles are soft, it's very easy for a little pressure to force the loose top off and then squeeze out the contents. Do yourself a favor and get the classic hard plastic travel bottles with the screw

reviews.t: chemical smell, I have no use for them
reviews.x: I have no use for these items because of terrible chemical smell and the blue one leaked bright dye after being washed; no way I'd put anything that goes on body into those. I tried to soak them for a long time but nothing helps. When I bought similar bottles from a store in person they didn't have any smell. I don't consider this item to be safe, these are not supposed to smell, the only way I'd use them is to put some industrial fluids in them, not anything for use on the body.

reviews.t: They work great! For the price.
reviews.x: They do not “click” shut......I traveled with these once.......I kept them in a plastic bag “just in case” they leaked.  ONE leaked very little (could have been user mistake, but....).  I use these in my shower DAILY.  They are small enough to not look messy.  They have large enough hole to make filling easy.  Love the different colors....  PERFECT size for traveling!  But I would put them in a ziplock bag for traveling to prevent any leakage onto clothing.

These are cute, decent-sized bottles and I think they’re great for traveling once in awhile. However, I wouldn’t use them at home or all of the time. At first they worked fine, but now (after just a few uses) the lids don’t shut properly so the shampoo/conditioner/soap can easily leak out. I also recommend using thicker substances in these as opposed to runnier substances - but I knew that ahead of time so no complaints there!

reviews.t: Cap is REALLY tight, doesn't leak when closed, hole for product is too big.
reviews.x: I tested these out with a gel facewash and a hand lotion; the lotion was fine but the facewash just leaked out as soon as I opened the cap and tipped the bottle slightly. That said, it doesn't leak at all when the cap is closed. The cap is very secure and honestly it kind of hurts my fingers to get it open because it's just so tight. Overall I wouldn't recommend them since the only real pro is that it doesn't leak.

I absolutely love these. Not only were they just a great deal for the quantity that you’re getting but the containers great as well. The containers are made out of silicone and the caps are made out of plastic. They do feel to be made out of good quality as the caps have a tight seal to them. So far I’ve used them on two trips and they haven’t spilled or anything. Definitely a good buy!

The last time I visited Costco, I bought a jug of hand sanitizer. But it was useless in the jug. So I was delighted to find the Travel Bottles. I filled them all with hand sanitizer. I now one in the car, one by my keyboard, and one spare. And I gave the pink one to a friend.  They don't leak and they work great for the reason I bought them.  They're a great idea!

This product was not leak proof. The containers were leaking even without squeezing the containers. I left the container on the table and noticed that the shampoo was leaking out of it. I placed these containers in my suitcase and when I took them out to use, half the shampoo in the container has already leaked out. I do not recommend this product.

I LOVE how wide the mouth makes them easy to fill! I love the size, the feel, and most of all that they DIDN'T LEAK.  I had no challenge getting exactly the amount of product I wanted it of the bottle. No trouble opening or closing the lids  So far, drove down to sea level and then back up to 7k feet with no leaks. I haven't flown with them yet.

These work very well. I got them because i wear long nails and i use lush lotions. They come in little pots and i always get the lotion under my nails. These are a great alternative. I fill them up and they hold a good amount of product before needing to be refilled. They squeeze out smooth and easy and i've even labeled them with a sharpie.

claims.text: Many reviewers report that the bottles leak, especially during travel or flying, which is the most common complaint.
Several reviewers find the bottles easy to fill, clean, and use, including one with rheumatoid arthritis.
Reviewers say the bottles work well for thicker products like lotions and creams but not for thin liquids such as hand sanitizer or oils.
Some reviewers note issues with the caps or labels, such as labels not sticking and caps losing function over time.
Multiple reviewers praise the bottles as convenient and perfect for travel, gym, or carrying in a purse or car.
